reason: The pre-correction parent source connected the FPGA WATCHDOG_TRIP_CLEAR command through R12003/R12004 to driven U4019 WD_M/O_TRIP_CLEAR_N outputs, creating output contention. A native pad/source match and zero regular DRC did not establish electrical correctness.
required_correction: Drive actual WD_REARM_M/O inputs on U4018 with an active-high default-low command; preserve U4019 ownership of WD_M/O_TRIP_CLEAR_N.
